evidence_summary: Official register identifies a pending Reserved Matters application for appearance, landscaping, layout and scale for 32 residential dwellings under outline permission SL/2021/0991. It lists proposed house-type elevations/floor plans and a Proposed Site Layout drawing 24131_01_P1. The public HTML register does not expose exact machine-readable Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for each distinct proposed/uncompleted dwelling footprint.
first_missing_criterion: exact machine-readable Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for each of the 32 distinct proposed/uncompleted dwelling footprints tied to planning reference 2025/0972/RMA
